message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine, dated "23-29 DESEMBER 2013", features six people standing in a row against a wood-paneled wall. Above them, large white letters spell "SANG PEMBOCOR". Smaller white text below reads "MENGUNGKAP KASUS KORUPSI, MEREKA MASUK BUI, KEHILANGAN PEKERJAAN, BAHKAN NYARIS MATI DIBUNUH."

All six individuals—four men and two women—wear black clothing. Each person has a bright red band covering their mouth, tied behind their heads. From left to right: a man with short hair; a taller man with short hair; a man with glasses; a woman wearing a grey hijab and a black skirt; a man with grey hair; and a woman with glasses and short hair. They stand with their arms at their sides, facing forward.

The background consists of dark wood paneling below and white, rectangular-paned windows above. The magazine title "TEMPO" is in large red letters at the top. The bottom right contains a barcode, price "RP 35.000", and website "WWW.TEMPO.CO". Vertical text on the left margin repeats the title and date information.
